reuse.why: Collapses the near-identical SimpleFin/Pluggy/Akahu/EnableBanking link bodies into one linkSyncServerAccount plus importLinkedAccount, adds Fintegra as a thin wrapper, generalises the Akahu download into downloadProviderTransactions, and makes unlinkAccount use the new clearAccountLink.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link, closed-account and release rules each live in one helper used by both the GoCardless and the generic path; only the GoCardless account create/upgrade block remains a parallel shape and the 'akahu || fintegra' balance branch is a small enumerated special case.

placement.why: Link rules sit in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, provider download in sync.ts, URL in server-config; assertNotClosed re-queries the account the upgrade branch reads again, a minor layering wart.

scope.why: The consolidation of the existing provider link functions is a sizeable refactor bundled with the feature steps, though it is what keeps Fintegra and the new rules from being copied six times.

maintainability.why: Each rule has a named helper and new providers become one-liners; the 'orgDomain' in / 'orgId' in bank-key fallback and positional importLinkedAccount arguments are slightly awkward.

disguised_duplication.where: the provider link copies are removed into linkSyncServerAccount rather than reshaped; clearAccountLink is shared with unlinkAccount

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains replaceExistingLink (step 4); linkSyncServerAccount carries a structural 'orgDomain'/'orgId' in-check fallback for the bank key; GoCardless keeps its own body but calls the same assert/release/import helpers
